annotation.description: Optional annotation or note about the cash raise request.

cancel_reason.description:
The machine-set reason a canceled raise was canceled. Null on a user/manual cancel and on non-canceled raises.
* superseded_by_edit: replaced by an instance regenerated after a schedule edit.
* detached_to_one_off: replaced by the standalone one-off created by a "this one" edit.
* reconciled_orphan: canceled by reconciliation as an un-activated instance off its schedule's cadence.
* schedule_deleted: canceled because its owning schedule was deleted.
* claimed_by_predecessor: a placeholder held by a schedule created by a "this and future" edit, for an occurrence whose raise still belongs to the schedule it replaced. Never funds.

completed_at.description: The time at which the cash was withdrawn or the cash raise was canceled.

completed_by.description: The user who marked the cash raise as complete or canceled.

activated_at.description: The date and time at which the cash raise's activation executed and its reservation was created. Null until then.

created_at.description: The date and time when the cash raise was created.

created_by.description: The advisor who created the cash raise request.

effective_at.description: The planned or actual activation date of the cash raise. Null when un-activated with no planned date.

id.description: The unique identifier of the cash raise.

liquidation_request.description: When true, the cash raise liquidates all available cash in the account rather than raising a fixed requested amount.

occurrence_date.description: The nominal cadence date of a schedule-generated raise, set together with schedule_id. Null on one-offs.

raised_amount.description: The amount of cash that has been withdrawn. This will be zero until the cash raise is complete.

request_type.description:
How the raise was created.
* ONE_TIME: a manual one-off raise.
* RECURRING: an instance generated by a recurring schedule.
* LIQUIDATION: a raise that liquidates all available cash (liquidation_request is true).

requested_amount.description: The amount of cash requested to be raised. 0 for liquidation raises (liquidation_request is true) — a liquidation has no fixed target.

schedule_id.description: The recurring schedule that generated this raise. Null on a manual one-off.

settled_cash.description: The amount of cash that is currently reserved for the cash raise. For complete and canceled cash raises, this will be zero.

status.description:
The current status of the cash raise.
* pending: The cash raise is active and in progress.
* ready_to_withdraw: The entire requested amount of cash is available for withdrawal in the account.
* cash_withdrawn: The cash has been withdrawn from the account.
* past_due: The cash raise is still pending (not enough cash is available yet) and its target date is in the past. A raise with enough cash available is reported as ready_to_withdraw even after its target date has passed.
* canceled: The cash raise has been canceled.
* pending_activation: The cash raise has not been activated yet, so no cash has been reserved or moved for it. Sleeve-scoped (DoD) accounts only.
* not_ready: The cash raise is activated but its cash is not available yet — either the account has a funding violation, or earlier-due raises still claim the available cash. Sleeve-scoped (DoD) accounts only.
* future: The cash raise has a planned activation date in the future and has not been activated. Sleeve-scoped (DoD) accounts only.

target_date.description: The target date by which the cash should be raised.

unsettled_cash.description: The amount of unsettled cash in the account. For complete and canceled cash raises, this will be zero.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the cash raise was last updated.
